name: NFD Korea Dangjin 300MW AI Data Center Campus
developer: NFD Korea (엔에프디코리아; ex-AWS/Brookfield DCI founders, CEO Choi Jae-woo)
notes: NFD Korea developing a 300MW AI-ready campus in Dangjin: 43,188 sqm, six 50MW buildings (phase 1 ~200MW, phase 2 ~100MW); land purchase completed, KEPCO power-supply contract signed and building permits received; phase 1 Ready-for-Service target Q1 2028. Confirmed by company release + ETNews + DCD (Jun 2026).

name: GNC Energy / DC Korea Dangjin Seokmun National Industrial Complex AI Data Center
notes: Chungnam, Dangjin, GNC Energy and DC Korea signed an MOU (Dec 2025) for a KRW 2 trillion AI data center in Seokmun National Industrial Complex; reported floor area 72,885 sqm on 33,673 sqm site, completion/investment through 2031, ~200 local jobs; MW not disclosed.

name: Geumsan Daejeon IDC / Data Center Site (Sanmaek-marketed)
notes: Local press describes Geumsan-gun as a leading data-center municipality; Sanmaek marketing site promotes a 'Daejeon Data Center' siting/construction solution in Geumsan. Public details on developer, capacity and construction status limited - weak lead only.

name: National Information Resources Service Gongju Backup / Disaster Recovery Center
developer: National Information Resources Service / Ministry of the Interior and Safety
notes: Government backup/disaster-recovery data center in Gongju; MOIS reporting says online/offline backup systems from NIRS Daejeon, Gwangju and Daegu were moved to Gongju and began operation 1 Oct 2025, with MOIS inspection 24 Oct 2025 (after the Daejeon NIRS fire). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Naepo New Town AI Data Center (Solis IDC)
developer: Solis IDC (솔리스아이디씨) / Mission Critical Engineering / Msys / ehostICT SPC
notes: Hongseong-gun/Chungnam announced an MOU (Mar 2020) for a private commercial AI data center in Naepo New Town Urban Advanced Industrial Complex (14,130 sqm site, KRW 270 billion); Solis IDC signed a land-purchase agreement with LH on 24 Mar 2020. Later construction status not confirmed in this pass; treat as planned/intent until updated evidence.

No datacenter projects found in Yesan-gun. Naepo New Town (host of the 2020 Naepo AI DC plan) straddles Hongseong-gun and Yesan-gun; the Naepo Urban Advanced Industrial Complex parcel is administered under Hongseong-gun, so the project is recorded under Hongseong-gun.

name: NAVER second data center proposal - Daegu Technopolis site (unsuccessful)
notes: Daegu submitted Dalseong-gun Technopolis research-facility land for NAVER's second data center bid in 2019; NAVER instead opened its second IDC as GAK Sejong, so the Daegu/Dalseong proposal is treated as unsuccessful rather than an active project.

name: National Information Resources Service Daegu Center (government cloud data center)
developer: National Information Resources Service / Ministry of the Interior and Safety (with Samsung SDS, KT Cloud, NHN Cloud)
notes: Government cloud data center (NIRS Daegu Center) opened 19 Jun 2024 in Daegu Dong-gu; MOIS Minister attended the opening; public-private cloud model with Samsung SDS, KT Cloud, NHN Cloud; hosts government cloud workloads with Gwangju/Daejeon/Gongju sites in the NIRS network. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LG U+ Daegu Center (KIDC Daegu)
notes: LG U+ official IDC page lists the Daegu center at 295-1 Dongin 1-ga / 186 Dongdeok-ro, Jung-gu, Daegu (KIDC Daegu), 20,000 kW power and Tier-3-class availability.

name: KT Daegu IDC (Bongdeok-dong)
notes: KT opened its Daegu IDC in the KT Daegu HQ building (Bongdeok-ro 61, Bongdeok-dong 627-15, Nam-gu) in Jan/Feb 2002 (bldg ~B1-4F, IDC-dedicated 1,000 kW power, 2nd floor); still listed in KT IDC center overviews. Operating facility; ~1 MW-scale.

name: SK Suseong Alpha City AI Data Center (SK REITs/SK C&C consortium) - scrapped
developer: SK REITs Management / SK C&C consortium (SK컨소시엄)
notes: Dec 2023 investment/cooperation agreement for an AI data center in Suseong Alpha City (KRW ~800 billion, 40 MW receiving capacity, 9,917 sqm site); Suseong Alpha City (76,728 pyeong) later designated an opportunity-development zone (Jun 2024). Jun 2026: SK exited the project - Yeongnam Ilbo/Maeil report the SK consortium pulled out (MOU signed ~2.5 years earlier), leaving the AI DC build effectively halted; Daegu city is seeking replacement operators. Status recorded as rejected/cancelled per negative-term verification (무산).

name: KR Logis Daejeon No.3 PFV Pyeongchon-dong Data Center
developer: KR Logis Daejeon No.3 PFV (케이알로지스대전제3호피에프브이) with Gangjin Industrial Development / K-REITs Investment Management
notes: Daedeok-gu signed a business agreement (30 Sep 2024) with KR Logis Daejeon No.3 PFV and partners to support construction of a data center in Pyeongchon-dong, Daedeok-gu; district provides administrative/permit support and local company recruitment promotion; capacity and construction timeline not yet published.
